title: Fake Course Materials Site
scenario: A site sells required textbooks at extreme discount and asks for card payment only.

answers.A: Verify inside the official university/account system.
answers.B: Click/apply/pay quickly before the deadline passes.
answers.C: Contact the relevant office using published contact details.
answers.D: Reply to the message and ask the sender for proof.

explanation: Fake Course Materials Site: the trap is to make money or value leave before the story is verified. The safer move is to verify through an official or approved channel, not to act before verifying.
proTip: Too-cheap course material sites often steal card data.
